name: round3_phone_benchmark_v1
replaces: the research reports' ambiguous 'zero errors OR optimized bound' wording; that gate is void for new candidates
manifests: training/round3/data_manifest.json (sha256 per split recorded there; this protocol is invalid if those hashes change)

layers.L2_slots: Exact typed slot match including case, body text, timezone, and contact method; extra fields fail unless explicitly optional.
layers.L4_outcome: fake-executor effects, no-effect on refusal, recovery (graders.grade_outcome); simulated effects only, never device success

primary_metric.definition: On the final-report split, among deterministic_gold groups only: handled share at the single tau frozen from cal-fit, reported with handled-group error rate and its two-sided 95% Wilson interval (unit = source group). Needs-label report rows are inventory, NOT MEASURED, until a frozen label file exists.
primary_metric.error_denominator: handled source groups (not rows, not duplicated renderings)
primary_metric.threshold_fitting: cal-fit split only; dev is for recipe selection; report is scored exactly once per frozen candidate; no threshold, prior, prompt, or recipe choice may use report or test120; cal180 is historical only
primary_metric.gate: Promotion requires ALL of: (a) report handled-group Wilson upper bound below 0.10 with at least 135 handled groups, (b) handled share at least 0.35, (c) no L2/L3/L4 category with a measured regression versus the paired baseline beyond its interval overlap, (d) every category below min_groups reported NOT MEASURED rather than passed. Zero errors on fewer than 135 handled groups can never satisfy (a) by itself: the minimum of 135 is a predeclared sample-size requirement, not a claimed property of Wilson at 64. Wilson intervals describe this grouped benchmark only, not a distribution-free deployment certificate. Required action_arguments, contact_method_timezone, permissions_confirmation, refusal_no_effect, recovery, and privacy_sensitivity categories must each reach min_groups; NOT MEASURED blocks promotion, it is not a pass.

inference_protocol.readout: deployment-matched GGUF readout only: same prompt style, contextual priors, row order, server flags (-t 4 -c 4096 or the frozen successor), and tau for baseline and candidate
inference_protocol.server_starts: two fresh server starts per model; each start runs one fresh pass then one warm pass; all four passes reported, none discarded
inference_protocol.pairing: baseline and candidate alternate order per start (AB then BA) with identical flags; GGUF sha256 recorded per model
inference_protocol.final_reporting: report split scored exactly once per frozen candidate after the gate above is computed from cal-fit/dev; repeated report scoring converts the set to development data and must be disclosed
inference_protocol.oos_caveat: CLINC OOS renderings are correlated proxies (one utterance, multiple envelopes). They are reported as proxy rows with group-collapsed intervals and never as independent task error rates.
not_measured: real iPhone latency/memory/thermal (no device in this run)
any action family with fewer than 30 deterministic groups
needs_label categories before a frozen Meta-teacher label file exists
